{{Top|ssprot|mprot}}
[[File:ChestMaleHuman.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker, a Human male, displays defined chest muscles beneath his breasts.]]
{{Quote|We're just having another dinner.''" [Leia breastfeeds Jaina]<br />"''They eat like starving Wookiees. Jacen done already?''"<br />"''Just wanted a snack, I guess. He'll probably want the second course in an hour or so.''"<br />"''I wish they'd get together on scheduling.''" [Jacen grips Han's finger] "''He's going to be a strong one.''"<br />"''You should feel the grip at this end.|Leia Organa Solo and Han Solo, discussing their infant twins|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Breasts''' were a functional anatomical feature in some [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that gave birth to live offspring and fed them with [[Milk/Legends|milk]] secreted by their mammary glands. Some non-mammalian species had the appearance of breasts, along with some [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] programming, but they did not have milk-producing mammary glands.<ref name="Note">For the purposes of this article, non-[[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that appear to have breasts on their chest will have those features conjecturally referred to as "breasts" based on visual resemblance, even though they are not identified as such in the sources cited.</ref>

==Mammalian species==
{{Quote|Jaina is fine&mdash;so is Mara.''"<br />"''So how come Mara isn't there?''"<br />"''Mara can't exactly drop what she's doing either. She's feeding Ben.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
One of the defining traits of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was nursing their newborn offspring<ref name="New Essential Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> with [[Milk/Legends|milk]] secreted by their mammary glands.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Among mammals that had breasts, the number varied with species, but two was common.<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" />

[[File:YarnadalGargan-PM.png|thumb|left|250px|Askajian females such as Yarna d'al' Gargan had six breasts.]]
[[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] gave birth to sets of up to six children, called cubs, and nursed them with their six breasts<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> that were grouped in pairs down their torso.<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Yarna d'al' Gargan]] was an Askajian who gave birth to four cublings, one of whom was killed when [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] captured her family. The surviving cublings were kept in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|town house]] while she was forced<ref name="Skin Deep">{{StoryCite|story=Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> to dance for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Though many beings considered her beautiful,<ref name="Out of the Closet">{{StoryCite|story=Out of the Closet: The Assassin's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Jabba made her wear wart-like makeup, and his audiences jeered and laughed when she danced.<ref name="Skin Deep" /> After Jabba's [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> she escaped his palace and used [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] she had secretly saved and then hidden between her lowest set of breasts to buy back her cublings.<ref name="Skin Deep" /> Working as a trader alongside the [[Geranite/Legends|Geranite]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Doallyn/Legends|Doallyn]], she sometimes danced by choice to earn extra [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. When she performed the [[Dance of the Seventy Violet Veils]] at the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]] of Leia Organa and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], she was spotted by an exotic lingerie designer who hired her to model his extravagantly jeweled [[Clothing/Legends|brassieres]].<ref name="Epilogue">{{StoryCite|story=Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

Other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species whose females had more than two breasts included [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], who had three<ref name="Goatgrass">{{StoryCite|story=Goatgrass: The Tale of Ree-Yees|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> grouped in a row,<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], who had six; accounts differ as to whether Wookiees nursed and birthed litters of cubs<ref name="Fact File 12">{{FactFile|12|WOO 1-4|Wookiees}}</ref> or only one at a time.<ref name="Essential Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> The number of breasts was variable among sows of the porcine [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] species. [[Matron/Legends|Matron]] [[Kufbrug]] of the [[Bolgoink clan]] had eight<ref name="Murder in Slushtime">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref> and Matron [[Bullyak]] of the [[Gakfedd tribe]] had six,<ref name="Children of the Jedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> but other sows had only one set of two breasts.<ref name="Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> Their breasts were grouped in pairs with additional sets below the others. Having a large body capable of supporting multiple [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Blood/Legends|bloodsuckers]] called [[morrt]]s was a status symbol amongst Gamorreans; thus, their presence was welcomed on the bosoms of [[Ugmush]], Kufbrug,<ref name="Murder in Slushtime" /> and Bullyak.<ref name="Children of the Jedi" />

It was common for females to nurse their young at their breasts in [[Human/Legends|Human]] cultures. On [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the [[Witches of Dathomir|warrior-women]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] breastfed their children in settings that included solemn councils of war.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> In the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker]] and [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] families, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] nursed her twins, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]];<ref name="The Last Command" /> [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] nursed her son, [[Ben Skywalker]];<ref name="Star by Star" /> and [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] nursed her daughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]]. To more easily feed Allana, Tenel Ka wore [[clothing]] with two nursing flaps.<ref name="The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> Humans infants could also be fed by other beings and methods, such as milk or formula dispensed into bottles by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Essential Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

[[File:KKruhk-SWMTDT-cropped.jpg|thumb|right|175px|K'Kruhk, a bare-breasted male Whiphid]]
For many mammalian species, male breast tissue generally conformed to the shape of the underlying muscles. For instance, the Human [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had defined muscles on his chest,<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> as did the Human males [[Mandalore the Lesser]],<ref name="Timeline 4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref> [[Aron Peacebringer]],<ref name="Star Wars 53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref> [[Galen Marek]],<ref name="The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> and the [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] leader [[Kar Vastor]].<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]]<ref name="Star Wars 2">[[Star Wars (1998) 2|''Star Wars'' (1998) 2]]</ref> and [[K'Kruhk]], a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]], also had such musculature.<ref name="Dark Times 7">[[Dark Times 7|''Dark Times'' 7]]</ref> An example of a Human male with larger breasts was [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who tamed and trained the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] kept in the dungeon beneath Jabba the Hutt's palace.<ref name="A Boy and His Monster">{{StoryCite|story=A Boy and His Monster: The Rancor Keeper's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

The [[Codru-Ji]] were born as canines and became four-armed humanoids in their adult life stage.<ref name="Essential Alien Species" /> Each pair of arms had a pair of breasts between them, and most were flat,<ref name="Planets and Moons" /> but the upper pair could be developed on female Codru-Ji.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Non-mammalian species==
===Amphibians and aquatic species===
[[File:MonCalamari-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Mon Calamari male and female with differing chest structures]]
The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowicks]],<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> [[Melodie]]s, [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubbs]],<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> [[Inleshat/Legends|Inleshats]],<ref name="Star Wars 74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref> and [[Issori]]<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> were some of the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] species whose offspring hatched from fertilized eggs,<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> yet they were also known to have at least one gender with anatomical features that resembled mammalian breasts. Rounded breasts were seen among the oviparous female Pa'lowicks,<ref name="Episode VI" /> Nautolans,<ref name="Agent of the Empire">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref> Melodies,<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> Issori,<ref name="Adventure Journal 13">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> Inleshats,<ref name="Star Wars 74" /> and Chagrians.<ref name="Legacy 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref> They were also seen on the aquatic-dwelling female [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]]<ref name="Crimson Empire">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 2]]</ref> and [[Qwohog (species)|Qwohogs]],<ref name="Wretched Hives">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> and the [[Iskalonian]] female [[Dania Francis]].<ref name="Star Wars 102">[[Star Wars (1977) 102|''Star Wars'' (1977) 102]]</ref> Female Mon Calamari had rounded breasts, but the chest structure of Mon Calamari males differed from that of mammals.<ref name="SWE Mon Calamari">{{SWE|groups|moncalamari|Mon Calamari}}</ref>

Unlike the breasts of male mammals,<ref name="CW 25">{{CW|25}}</ref> nipples or similar features were not apparent on the breasts of male Inleshats,<ref name="Star Wars 74" /> Nautolans, Quarrens,<ref name="CW 5">{{CW|5}}</ref> or Shawda Ubbs.<ref name="Episode VI SE">{{Film|VI}} {{C|[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] onward}}</ref> Qwohog males, however, appeared to have nipples.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

===Gastropods===
{{Quote|About ''time'' you showed up again, Cade. I was beginnin' to feel lonely and... ''neglected."<br/>"''You were always too much woman for ''me'', Jool. How's business?|Queen Jool and [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy 14">[[Legacy (2006) 14|''Legacy'' (2006) 14]]</ref>}}
[[File:Quockran.png|thumb|right|250px|Quockrans were gastropods that had breasts.]]
Unlike bipedal species, the bodies of [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropods]] acted as a large foot to move themselves.<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> Despite their anatomical differences from bipeds and from mammals, [[Quockran]]s had a pair of heavy breasts that each had a small protrusion.<ref name="Alien Encounters" />

Multiple female [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had a pair of breasts, such as the crime lords [[Prello Anjiliac]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy">''[[Scum and Villainy]]''</ref> and [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> The mother of multiple Hutts including [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], many of [[Mama/Legends|Mama's]] features were larger in size than those of other Hutts.<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Hutt pin-up/Legends|pin-up poster]] of a Hutt could be seen in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Underworld]].<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> Queen [[Jool]], owner of [[Rik's Cantina/Legends|Rik's Cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Legacy 14" /> and [[Paradise (cantina)|Paradise]] on [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], regularly wore clothing over her breasts, including a floral-patterned swim top when she soaked in outdoor pools.<ref name="Legacy 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref>

===Plant-based===
Some sentient [[Plant/Legends|plant-based]] species had breasts. [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] was a [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]] tree-like [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] whose [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] form included breasts.<ref name="Star Wars 34">[[Star Wars (1998) 34|''Star Wars'' (1998) 34]]</ref> The [[Zelosian]] species, which was classified as [[Near-Human]], was believed to have either descended from intelligent plant life or been genetically engineered. Though they were visually indistinguishable from humans, their skin photosynthesized like leaves,<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> they had cellulose fibers in their muscles, and their circulatory systems contained green<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> [[Chlorophyll/Legends|chlorophyllic]] sap.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy 2">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref>

===Reptiles===
{{Quote|You seem pensive. And so unfortunately melancholy. How that grieves me! Perhaps it would be better if we let the past be the past. And let go of those thorny memories that impinge upon the tender flesh of our bosoms.|The arachnid Kud'ar Mub'at, to the reptilian Bossk|<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Greeata.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Greeata Jendowanian, a female Rodian dancer and musician]]
[[Reptile/Legends|Reptilian]] species reproduced by laying fertilized eggs.<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] females were physically distinguished from males by their mammary glands;<ref name="Note: Rodian">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''. The book classifies [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] as [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]], yet says, "In addition, females are physically distinguished by their mammary glands." It is unclear if this is intended to mean Rodian [[Gender/Legends|females]] have [[Milk/Legends|milk]]-producing mammary glands, or simply the ''appearance'' of the type of mammary glands called breasts in [[Primate/Legends|primates]].</ref> as such, off-world female Rodians would sometimes clothe themselves in ways that obscured their shape and shave their heads, and at other times, they would display their physique.<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /> For instance, [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]] was a Rodian member of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] who performed at Jabba's Palace in clothing that revealed her shape and her scales.<ref name="Episode VI SE" />

Despite being a species that emerged from eggs as tadpoles, breasts were one of the many anatomical differences between female and male [[Serp]]s.<ref name="Star Wars 64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref> Females of the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] species had breasts<ref name="Star Wars 40">[[Star Wars (1998) 40|''Star Wars'' (1998) 40]]</ref> despite laying clutches of eggs,<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> and small breasts were apparent on females of the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]]<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] species.<ref name="Unknown Soldier">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>

In various accounts of reptilian species characteristics, [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] females were said to be almost identical visually and physically to males, with the most notable differences being their smaller spinal ridges,<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /><ref name="Alien Encounters" /><ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> the extent of their color-changing abilities, and cultural choices such as how they wore their hair.<ref name="New Essential Alien Species" /><ref name="Alien Encounters" /> Although not documented as a gender difference, female Falleen of multiple galactic eras were known to have breasts, such as [[Darth Karrid]],<ref name="TOR Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> [[Zule Xiss]],<ref name="Republic 56">[[Republic 56|''Republic'' 56]]</ref> and [[Savan]].<ref name="SotE Evolution 1">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 1|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 1]]</ref>

Though [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] were reptiles without breasts, the arachnid [[Assembler]] [[Kud'ar Mub'at]] still referred to the Trandoshan [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and himself as having a bosom.<ref name="Slave Ship" />

===Other species===
The skin of [[Myneyrsh]]i was covered with a smooth layer of glass-like crystal. The four-armed beings had a pair of breasts between each pair of arms<ref name="Essential Alien Species" /> that were rounded on at least one female<ref name="Purge">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 1]]</ref> but were otherwise flat.<ref name="Essential Alien Species" />

[[Groff Zugga]], leader of the [[Galactic Spice Mining Guild]] and [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] host, had four rounded breasts beneath his chin, with his smallest pair in the center and nipples on each.<ref name="Episode I Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==Droids==
[[File:TDL_Nanny_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Based on AccuTronics' market research, the TDL nanny droid dispensed bottled milk from an internal reservoir, but did not simulate breast-feeding.]]
The [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] known as [[SCORPIO]] was created sometime during the [[Manderon Period]]. She had feminine programming and many features in common with [[GEMINI Prime]] and the [[GEMINI]] series of droids, but unlike the GEMINI droids, her plating included breasts.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Available during the Clone Wars, [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droids]] from [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech Enterprises]] prioritized aesthetics over practical functions. They were intended to resemble and move like an attractive human female, but their programming underperformed considering their high price point.<ref name="New Essential Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Also during that era, a [[Droid Spa/Legends|droid spa]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]] attendants, [[SN-D1/Legends|SN-D1]] and [[BO-N1/Legends|BO-N1]], that had convex chest plates resembling a humanoid bosom.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>

[[Human replica droid]]s created by [[Massad Thrumble]] that had the appearance of Human females, such as [[Guri]], were given breasts covered with [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]].<ref name="New Essential Droids" /> While otherwise inspired by Thrumble's work, [[Alessi Quon]] deliberately omitted synthskin when he created [[IN-GA 44]] so she would retain a droid's appearance despite her humanoid shape.<ref name="AotE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref>

The [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]] [[TDL nanny droid]] mimicked a humanoid figure with the appearance of breasts, a torso and arms covered with synthskin warmed to human body temperature, and had the option to replicate the mother's [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromone]] pattern and scent. In order to dispense warmed milk or formula into a bottle as needed, up to two liters were stored and refrigerated<ref name="Essential Droids" /> within its internal milk reservoir. After AccuTronics' market research found that parents would be disturbed by simulated breast-feeding capabilities, the feature was omitted.<ref name="Fact File 94">{{FactFile|94|TDL 1-2|TDL Nanny Droid}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Somewhere along the way, in one of those conversations that was beer-induced, we said, 'Oh, and she has six breasts!' And somehow it was appropriate for Jabba's palace.|Costume designer [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]|<ref name="Insider 158">{{InsiderCite|158|Star Wars Style Part 6: Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'' Style Part 6: ''Return of the Jedi''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Familytoys.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Kenner prototypes of Chewbacca's family]]
For the [[1978]] television special, ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] created prototype toys for [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]], including his wife, [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Malla]]. This prototype, however, depicted Malla with two defined breasts,<ref name="Insider 92">{{InsiderCite|92|The Toys That Never Were}}</ref> despite breasts not being readily apparent in her television appearance.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> [[George Lucas]] described Wookiee females as having six breasts and delivering litters of offspring in a [[Wikipedia:Time (magazine)|''Time'']] magazine interview coinciding with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Time">{{BookCite|author=Clarke, Gerald|container=Show Business: I've Got to Get My life Back Again|title=[[Wikipedia:Time (magazine)|''Time'']]|number=Vol. 121 #21|publisher=[[Wikipedia:Time Inc.|Time Inc.]]|date=1983-05-23|issn=0040-781X|quote=Chewbacca is a favorite of Lucas', and he can go on and on about the Wookie ''[sic]'' tribe. They come from a damp jungle planet where they reside in tree houses and live to be 350 years old. The six-breasted females deliver their offspring in litters.|link=https://web.archive.org/web/20191223102716/http://content.time.com/time/subscriber/article/0,33009,953916-3,00.html}}</ref> However, female Wookiees have been variously depicted in visual media as flat-chested,<ref name="Diversity Alliance">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref> having a slightly curved chest<ref name="Star Wars 91">[[Star Wars (1977) 91|''Star Wars'' (1977) 91]]</ref> or with two visible breasts.<ref name="Chewbacca 1">[[Chewbacca (2000) 1|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 1]]</ref> Lucas's vision of six breasts appeared in text in the Wookiee entry of [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 12|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 12]], published in [[2002]].<ref name="Fact File 12" />

[[File:MonCalamariBreast.jpg|thumb|150px|''Star Wars Galaxies'' rejected concept of a Mon Calamari with breasts]]
According to ''Return of the Jedi'' costume designer [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], the decision to give Yarna d'al' Gargan six breasts occurred under the influence of alcohol. To achieve the appearance, her costume incorporated a [[Wikipedia:Foam latex|foam latex]] [[Wikipedia:Prosthetic makeup|prosthetic]] on her stomach.<ref name="Insider 158" /> The prosthetic was fabricated by [[Industrial Light & Magic]] and shipped to London for [[Claire Davenport]] to wear during her scenes.<ref name="Wiebba-Wiebba">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-mysteries-who-is-wiebba-wiebba|series=Star Wars Mysteries|text=Who is Wiebba-Wiebba?}}</ref> Kenner intended to release an action figure of Gargan for their [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1985 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'']] toy line. The figure had reached an intermediate prototype stage and its collector coin was designed when [[Lucasfilm]] put a stop to production, apparently considering the six-breasted dancer inappropriate for a children's toy.<ref name="Insider 92">{{InsiderCite|92|The Toys That Never Were}}</ref> She eventually received an action figure in [[2008]] as part of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]''.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=#06: Yarna d'al' Gargan|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC06Yarna.asp}}</ref>

During the development of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the team worked with Lucasfilm to determine the female Mon Calamari's physiology. Because Mon Calamari were not mammals, early concepts showing Mon Calamari with breasts were eventually rejected.<ref name="From Pencil to Pixel">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref> However, later female Mon Calamari were depicted with breasts, such as the [[Mon Calamari Ballet]] dancer in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]<ref name="Art of ROTS">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> and the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' version of [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]].<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

The [[2010]] art book [[Star Wars Art: Visions|''Star Wars Art: Visions'']] featured the artwork ''Sleeping Aayla'' by [[Evan Wilson]]: it depicted [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] sleeping while wearing an open kimono, which showed one of her breasts.<ref name="Star Wars Art: Visions">''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''</ref>
